checks.market summary: More homes are for sale than a year ago and they’re taking longer to sell. Sales were down 6.6% from a year ago. Benchmark prices are close to where they were last year, and homes sold for 97.5% of their asking price on average. With 4.8 months of inventory, up from 4.1, buyers have more choice and more room to negotiate.
